about: Through real cargo tree over a planted workspace: canopi-format reaches tokio two edges away (through runtime), which cargo-deny's wrappers cannot see, and canopi-format-wasm reaches it through canopi-format, a subtree --no-dedupe repeats, and rusqlite and schemars directly; tauri, only a dev-dependency, is no site (design check F9)

files.Cargo.toml:
# The format-crate-bans-native rule's planted violation (§18 R7, design check F9): a workspace of its own (so the
# repository's cargo never reads it) whose crates are named like the guarded format crates and the banned native ones.
# canopi-format reaches tokio two edges away (through runtime), which cargo-deny's wrappers cannot see; canopi-format-wasm
# depends on rusqlite and schemars. tauri is only a dev-dependency, which never ships, so it is no site.
[workspace]
members = ["canopi-format", "canopi-format-wasm", "runtime", "tokio", "rusqlite", "schemars", "tauri"]
resolver = "2"
files.Cargo.lock:
# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
# It is not intended for manual editing.
version = 4

[[package]]
name = "canopi-format"
version = "0.1.0"
dependencies = [
 "runtime",
 "tauri",
]

[[package]]
name = "canopi-format-wasm"
version = "0.1.0"
dependencies = [
 "canopi-format",
 "rusqlite",
 "schemars",
]

[[package]]
name = "runtime"
version = "0.1.0"
dependencies = [
 "tokio",
]

[[package]]
name = "rusqlite"
version = "0.1.0"

[[package]]
name = "schemars"
version = "0.1.0"

[[package]]
name = "tauri"
version = "0.1.0"

[[package]]
name = "tokio"
version = "0.1.0"
files.canopi-format/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "canopi-format"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
runtime = { path = "../runtime" }

[dev-dependencies]
tauri = { path = "../tauri" }
files.runtime/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "runtime"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
tokio = { path = "../tokio" }
